crawl_scope.rule: Followed collection pagination in order until a page returned zero product URLs.

interpretation_notes: Observed labels retain source capitalization, punctuation, and wording; aliases are grouped under conservative canonical fields.
Any label not confidently mapped remains under 'Other — exact label preserved' rather than being discarded.
Value examples are verbatim observed PDP text (up to five per exact label and eight per canonical field); row-level values for every PDP are in the companion raw-records file.
Format tags are descriptive pattern matches, not conversions or claims of normalized units.
Some PDPs expose composite values with named subfields in the value string; these are retained verbatim.
Unmatched standalone source lines are retained under unparsed_source_lines and are not guessed into key/value pairs.
